source: Ground Broken in Construction of Newton's Space Elevator

source: The City of Newton's ambitions as a spacefaring power were brought a step closer to realisation last night, as the captured asteroid 40448-Columbiad was moved into a geostationary orbit above the equatorial city. The operation, carried out by drones whose success was confirmed by ground-control
target: 昨晚，被捕获的小行星40448-Columbiad移入赤道城市牛顿市上方的地球同步静止轨道，使这座城市成为航天强国的雄心，又向现实迈进了一步。此次行动由无人机实施，并于昨天上午由地面控制

source: teams yesterday morning, represents the first major step in the construction of Newton's space elevator. The asteroid will serve as the 'anchor' for the elevator, and must now be connected to the grounding platform on the Earth's surface. [

source: "We are extremely proud of what our engineers have been able to accomplish," commented Councillor Diane Lee. "Newton's equatorial position made it the obvious choice for this project, and we forsee easy access to space as potentially one of our biggest exports." [

流行乐团寻求庇护

source: The popular boy-band 'U-Phonix', currently on a world tour including Eurofed, Newton and SoCal, have been sentenced to death in absentia by a court in their home state of Oklahoma. The verdict, issued by the presiding judge Pastor William Phipps of the "Patriotic Tribunal Board", was given after accusations of treasonous conduct, blasphemy and "incitement to immorality on an unprecedented scale".
target: 人气男子组合“U-Phonix”正进行世界巡演，行程包括欧洲联邦、牛顿市和南加州。近日，他们被故乡俄克拉何马的一家法院缺席判处死刑。“爱国法庭委员会”的主审法官威廉·菲普斯牧师，依据叛国、亵渎神明以及“以空前规模煽动不道德行为”等指控，作出了这一判决。

source: While not acting as part of the legal government of Oklahoma (currently occupied by Concord peacekeepers), the ruling by an influential community figure carries a great deal of weight with much of its population, making it no longer safe for the group to return.
